rawFindings.title: Incorrect Content-Type when sending number as second argument with status
rawFindings.explanation: The new code distinguishes between res.send(status) and res.send(status, num). When sending res.send(status, num) with num as a number, it should send num serialized as JSON with Content-Type 'application/json'. The code sets Content-Type to JSON only inside the case when body is a number argument 2; however, when res.send(status) is called with one numeric argument, Content-Type is 'text/plain'.
rawFindings.suggestion: Ensure that when res.send(status, num) is called and num is a number, Content-Type should be set to 'application/json', and the number sent as JSON string. The added test in test/res.send.js confirms this behavior, so no further fix needed unless any errors.
